title: From a point, a world
scope: An authored capacity tree for Primitives → Transformation, with two later returns. This is a revisable route through existing material, not a prerequisite order for every artifact in the museum.
rules: Keep understanding, usable construction and cultural association distinct.
An edge proposes a specific relationship, not documented code inheritance or universal historical descent.
In Void means an implementation is placed; it does not certify every interaction or headset performance.
A source in the museum is not automatically a reusable Void building piece.
Keep the recipe and stable identity when carrying an object forward.

nodes.title: A running world
nodes.subtitle: Time / update
nodes.understand: Initialization creates the object; repeated updates change its state.
nodes.build: A counter; later, time-driven movement.
nodes.gap: A clock supplies time. It does not itself supply a movement rule.

nodes.title: Point
nodes.subtitle: Position / variable
nodes.understand: Give one position a name. A visible sphere represents the point; it has a size that the mathematical point does not.
nodes.build: One visible body that later receives interaction.
nodes.gap: Keep the same learner object across the lesson handoff.

nodes.title: A point in the hand
nodes.subtitle: Local / world coordinates
nodes.understand: Pickup changes who controls the body. Read its position relative to its parent and to the world.
nodes.build: A movable endpoint and a spatial control.
nodes.gap: This lesson focuses on pickup and reference frames, not distance calculation.

nodes.title: Line
nodes.subtitle: Two endpoints / relation
nodes.understand: Two positions define a finite segment. Their difference gives displacement; its length gives distance.
nodes.build: Connect, measure, align, cross or follow.
nodes.gap: A visible segment only becomes a physical beam when width and collision are supplied.

nodes.title: Trace
nodes.subtitle: Array / loop / condition
nodes.understand: Keep sampled positions in order. Accept a new entry when it is far enough from the last; connect neighbours.
nodes.build: A drawn path that can be kept and used again.
nodes.gap: Separate the original record from a transformed or snapped result.

nodes.title: Grid
nodes.subtitle: Address / quantization
nodes.understand: Assign sampled positions to cells; compare an address with a continuous position.
nodes.build: Replay the retained trace in the shaft grid.
nodes.gap: A grid address is not yet a construction joint or a walkable block.

nodes.title: Triangle
nodes.subtitle: Three corners / one face
nodes.understand: Three non-collinear positions define a planar triangle; index order determines its facing.
nodes.build: An explicit surface and a component of a larger mesh.
nodes.gap: A triangle mesh is not automatically a physical support.

nodes.title: Closed body
nodes.subtitle: Shared vertices / face list
nodes.understand: Join faces through shared corner indices to enclose a volume.
nodes.build: Tetrahedra, prisms and other bodies made from known faces.
nodes.gap: Closure, outward normals and collision are separate things to check.

nodes.title: Walkable wedge
nodes.subtitle: wp / support / ascent
nodes.understand: An inclined surface connects two heights. The original wp rises 1 m over a 2 m run.
nodes.build: A slope joining ordinary floor to a raised landing.
nodes.gap: Restore this exact module in the Void kit; preserve its footprint, origin and collision.

nodes.title: Cube
nodes.subtitle: Eight corners / reusable body
nodes.understand: The same eight corner positions support twelve surface triangles. Place an instance without changing those local positions.
nodes.build: A candidate one-metre landing, block or support.
nodes.gap: The tutorial CubeBody currently has no collider. The reusable walkable variant still needs one.

nodes.title: Walkable construction
nodes.subtitle: Wedge + cube + valid joins
nodes.understand: A relation between bodies creates a continuous route. Test the joins at the scale of the player.
nodes.build: A slope leading onto a one-metre landing, then a longer crossing.
nodes.gap: Missing link: shared buildable modules with consistent dimensions, collision and editor connections.

nodes.title: Transformation
nodes.subtitle: Position / rotation / scale
nodes.understand: Change a whole body through time while retaining its identity and local shape recipe.
nodes.build: The existing still, rise, turn and pulse demonstrations in Trans_Pre.
nodes.gap: The trial demonstrates transforms. Passenger-carrying moving architecture is a separate, unbuilt connection.

nodes.title: Carried light
nodes.subtitle: Point → beacon
nodes.understand: A small source can alter the visible space around a moving body.
nodes.build: The shiny black point lights the basin while held.
nodes.gap: Association gives the object another use; lighting is not a mathematical property of a point.

nodes.title: Ruler
nodes.subtitle: Line → measure
nodes.understand: Read an endpoint displacement using declared units and drawing scale.
nodes.build: The 1:10 plan measure and 1:1 full-size ruler.
nodes.gap: Keep scale and units visible; a short representation can refer to a much larger distance.

nodes.title: DO NOT CROSS
nodes.subtitle: Line → boundary
nodes.understand: A line can carry an instruction. Its meaning and its physical obstruction are distinct.
nodes.build: Blue wooden barricade, tape and construction fence.
nodes.gap: These are authored associations, not geometric consequences of having two endpoints.

nodes.title: Beam / plank
nodes.subtitle: Line → thickness + support
nodes.understand: Give a segment a section and a physical surface; now a body can rest on or cross it.
nodes.build: Existing timber and black steel pieces in the tower.
nodes.gap: Pieces exist; a common snapped construction recipe and connection rules still need adding.

nodes.title: A line opens a door
nodes.subtitle: Relation → condition → action
nodes.understand: A chosen relation between two held points can trigger an event.
nodes.build: The two-point puzzle and construction-fence door.
nodes.gap: The opening condition is an authored game rule, not the definition of every line.

nodes.title: Drawn light
nodes.subtitle: Trace → luminous path
nodes.understand: A saved path can drive a mesh and a bounded lighting response.
nodes.build: The trace illuminates the drawing area.
nodes.gap: Emission and illumination are different. Avoid one live light for every recorded point.

nodes.title: Brace / truss
nodes.subtitle: Triangle → construction frame
nodes.understand: A triangular arrangement makes edges and joins legible at architectural scale.
nodes.build: The large construction triangles and folded strip.
nodes.gap: These authored frames do not simulate structural engineering; do not claim tested load capacity.

nodes.title: Directional sign
nodes.subtitle: Triangle → orientation / meaning
nodes.understand: The same outline can face up, down, left or right and acquire a different reading.
nodes.build: The triangle signs on round plates.
nodes.gap: Distinguish rotating the shape from the cultural instruction it carries.

nodes.title: Column family
nodes.subtitle: Profile / height / resolution
nodes.understand: Separate outline, height and angular sampling. More segments do not guarantee a better sculpture.
nodes.build: Columns at different heights, outlines and resolutions.
nodes.gap: A standing mesh is not automatically an engineering support.

nodes.title: Letters become space
nodes.subtitle: Outline → passage / vessel
nodes.understand: An outline and its holes can be carried through depth to form a body or passage.
nodes.build: Existing letter-profile architecture.
nodes.gap: Preserve counters (holes); collision and walkable clearance need checking for each variant.

nodes.title: Bridge / landing
nodes.subtitle: Construction → crossing
nodes.understand: Combine known support surfaces into a route with a readable beginning and end.
nodes.build: A reusable wedge–landing–beam assembly over the Void.
nodes.gap: Existing planks are not yet this shared assembly. Test gaps, head clearance and approach in both player modes.

nodes.title: Saved assembly
nodes.subtitle: Parts / identity / placement
nodes.understand: Keep the recipe so a construction can be reopened, edited and reused.
nodes.build: Named sets of typed pieces, XYZ positions, dimensions, joints and behaviour.
nodes.gap: The editor saves individual objects today. A reusable assembly definition with typed joints is still proposed.

nodes.title: Moving landing
nodes.subtitle: Translate the construction
nodes.understand: Position changes through time; a supported player must travel with the surface.
nodes.build: A lift that reconnects two heights.
nodes.gap: Original lift code exists, but the shared wedge/cube assembly and Void passenger behaviour are not established.

nodes.title: Turning bridge
nodes.subtitle: Rotate around a pivot
nodes.understand: The pivot determines the swept path and which end remains attached.
nodes.build: A bridge that opens a gap or reconnects a route.
nodes.gap: Test passenger motion, swept collision and safe restart; an animated display is insufficient.

nodes.title: Changing span
nodes.subtitle: Scale / available clearance
nodes.understand: Changing dimensions changes reach and clearance as well as appearance.
nodes.build: A crossing that extends or a passage whose width changes.
nodes.gap: A scaled collider and a player standing on it need their own contract and test.

nodes.title: Repeat a recipe
nodes.subtitle: Arrays / tiling
nodes.understand: Keep a source and produce multiple placed instances with a rule.
nodes.build: Later repeated supports, modules and surface patterns.
nodes.gap: Existing museum lessons; carrying this proposed Void construction kit into them still needs a trial.

nodes.title: Give form a surface
nodes.subtitle: Colour / shaders
nodes.understand: Evaluate colour or a surface response from declared inputs.
nodes.build: Later materials, signals and spatially varying surfaces on the same bodies.
nodes.gap: Existing museum capacities; this tree proposes their return to the building kit, not a completed integration.

edges.label: add pickup and a reference frame
close three edges into a face
choose corners from the carried record
choose eight corners and twelve triangles
initialize a body in the running world
give the segment thickness and collision
use an endpoint relation as a condition
let an outline organise a space
join low and high walking surfaces
save the editable parts and relations
carry this same construction into motion
